dct_title_s: General plan for Cedar Lake Boulevard showing connection with Lake of the Isles and Dean Boulevards, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan for Cedar Lake Boulevard, in Minneapolis, Minnesota, showing the connection with Lake of the Isles and Dean Boulevards. The plan is found in the Twenty-seventh Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page [86].
